1) Shift live demo to Thurs 11/5 10:00 PT (preferred)
2) Shift to Fri 11/6 09:00 PT
3) Keep Wed 11/4 10:00 PT, run as planned, record a concise 20-min walk-through and schedule a 30-min live Q&A for Thurs or Fri so you can join the QA session.
